title: Soaring diesel prices are clobbering Trump’s MAGA faithful, exposing rifts
description: Pain at the pump for rural Republicans is shifting the political map.

title: This Texas crooner could help Democrats win Congress, one quinceañera at a time
description: Bobby Pulido would be the only member of Congress with a Latin Grammy to his name. That comes with its upsides and downsides.

title: As former athletes, some Senators have extra say on the college sports reform bill
description: As Senate considers a major college sports reform bill lobbied for by the NCAA and other powerful stakeholders, some lawmakers — themselves former college athletes — have a major say in the debate.

title: Ohio governor's race: Ramaswamy and Acton clash in rare Democratic pickup opportunity
description: The Ohio governor's race pits Vivek Ramaswamy against Democrat Amy Acton. While Ramaswamy downplays his Trump tie and Acton faces pandemic-era scrutiny, Democrats eye a rare win in 40 years

title: Politics chat: Trump vs the media; rolling back health and education spending
description: We look at President Trump's fight with some of the White House press corps, as well as his attempt to claw back $810 million in Congressionally-approved funds for health and education spending.

title: These Democrats are running for Congress on Christian faith. Will it pay off?
description: It's rare for Democrats to make religion a centerpiece of their campaigns. But this midterm election cycle, a number of candidates for Congress are doing just that.

title: Lawmakers slam Trump’s move to cancel $810M in funding approved by Congress
description: The White House announced plans to cancel funding for refugee services and other domestic programs. Lawmakers say it infringes on their spending authority.

title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
description: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

title: A past FBI inquiry complicates Susan Collins’s campaign message in Maine
description: News of a probe involving political contributions and federal contracts has some in a shipyard town raising questions about her influence.

title: Trump heads to Texas-Tennessee football game as midterm rallies slide
description: Trump will attend the Tennessee-Texas college football game on Saturday and the President’s Cup golf tournament on Sunday.

title: Men who allegedly targeted Trump’s UFC fight converged online. Most never met.
description: Prosecutors say the plan was coordinated between men in at least six states, taking shape in mere weeks ahead of the June 14 event at the White House.

title: Democrats now have easier paths to flipping the Senate. Here are races to watch.
description: The goal of keeping Democratic Senate seats and flipping four GOP seats once felt like a long shot. Now it's feasible.

title: Press pool dispute escalates as White House cuts CNN from Air Force One travel
description: The White House has barred CNN from traveling on Air Force One this weekend. It's another chapter in President Trump's fight with the press, and it appears there will be no TV pool coverage today.

title: Supreme Court rejects GOP-backed Missouri map, preserving key seat for Democrats
description: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a Republican attempt at redistricting congressional seats in Missouri - possibly giving Democrats a boost in their effort to win the House in the midterm elections.

title: Week in Politics: Trump faces Republican defections; U.S.-China summit; press feud
description: Some GOP candidates are stepping back from unpopular Trump administration policies. Meanwhile, a U.S.-China summit at the White House and tensions with the press corps.

title: Battle for the Lehigh Valley: Can GOP hold its razor-thin margin?
description: Both parties target the Lehigh Valley for House control. While the GOP made inroads with Latinos, Dems argue Trump's immigration stance hurts them. Can Republicans hold this 1% margin swing seat?

title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
description: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

title: White House has not acted on RFK Jr.’s push for proof ultra-processed foods are safe
description: A draft letter obtained by The Post shows Kennedy’s favorable response to a petition that food experts said could lead to significant changes for the industry.

title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri congressional map favoring GOP for third time
description: The ruling ends a complicated legal fight that has injected uncertainty into November’s midterm elections in the state.

title: Jury in Trayon White Sr. bribery trial says it can’t reach verdict
description: White was charged with accepting $35,000 from a D.C. government contractor in exchange for agreeing to pressure D.C. officials to renew contracts that his companies had obtained for violence-interruption services.

title: Trump embraces Xi as a peer, testing a new approach to China
description: The presidents praised their relationship over tea and viewed America’s founding documents, with few apparent breakthroughs on the issues dividing their countries.

title: New Jersey lieutenant governor resigns after report finds harassment, ethics violations
description: An investigation found that Lt. Gov. Dale Caldwell sexually harassed a woman and violated state ethics rules. He denied allegations of misconduct, and Gov. Mikie Sherrill said Caldwell had stepped down on Friday.

title: Pentagon quietly adds dozens to tally of troops wounded amid Iran war
description: With the addition of 29 U.S. sailors and eight Marines, the total number of personnel wounded since the start of hostilities has risen to 861, a Pentagon database shows.

title: Government can use Social Security data to identify noncitizen voters, Supreme Court rules
description: President Donald Trump wants to let states use a federal database that includes voters’ personal information to check for noncitizens on voter rolls.

title: Bipartisan group of senators urge Trump to disinvite Putin from G-20
description: Top senators on the Armed Services and Foreign Relations committees argue the invitation legitimizes the Russian assault on Ukraine.

title: Saudis have not ruled out developing nuclear weapons, U.S. intelligence assesses
description: The sobering outlook has compounded concerns from some U.S. lawmakers about President Donald Trump’s agreement to assist the kingdom with establishing a civilian nuclear program.

title: Republican senators are starting to break from Trump in noticeable ways
description: And what else happened this week in the Trump administration.

title: Trump’s newest rebranding project: The technology formerly known as AI
description: He’s trying to label the technology as “superintelligence” and says he pitched the term to Xi Jinping.
